indications.trial_design: Planned Phase IIa clinical trial of JOTROL in Parkinson's disease; FDA IND cleared November 2025; clinical supplies manufactured by Catalent; trial start anticipated 2026

indications.trial_name: JOTROL Phase 1 PK study (cross-referenceable for MCI/AD development)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 single/multiple-ascending dose pharmacokinetic study (up to 500 mg) demonstrating CMax >800 ng/mL without severe AEs; results published in AAPS Open 2022 and intended to support Phase 2 indications
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 completed; Phase 2 in MCI/AD planned to follow Parkinson's program
key_milestones: FDA agreed Phase 1 supports IND for Phase IIa indications
